pages.title: Food and Health
pages.text: AppleSkin shows what food does. Food tooltips list hunger and [#](7A3C9A)[saturation](entry://glossary/saturation)[#](), the hunger bar shows how much a held item would restore, and saturation appears as an overlay. Useful with the larger food list of [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

pages.title: Food Values
pages.text: AppleSkin adds hunger and saturation values to food tooltips. Hold food to preview the refill on the bar.

pages.title: Related survival
pages.text: Thirst has its own bar: [#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#](). Seasons decide what you can grow: [#](2E5AAC)[Seasons](entry://survival/seasons)[#](). [#](2E5AAC)[Cold Sweat](entry://survival/temperature)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Smog](entry://survival/pollution)[#]() add their own hazards. Early food by area: [#](2E5AAC)[Food in Your First Days](entry://food/first_food)[#]().
